player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors game.
Your goal is to win as many rounds as possible.
In each round, respond with one of: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
You may also use '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' as shorthand.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hii si mwendo unaotambulika. Utumie [rock], [paper], au [scissors].

outcome.p0_wins: Mũthaaki wa namba 0 nĩwe wathaga macindano maingĩ!
outcome.p1_wins: Mũthaaki wa mbere nĩwe wathaga macindano maingĩ!
